summary: Iteration 6 validated mobile-first responsive design across the app on both viewports (mobile 390x844 and desktop 1440x900). All explicit requirements from the review request PASS. Mobile: top bar with hamburger (mobile-menu-toggle) is visible, sidebar starts off-screen at x=-256, opening drawer shifts aside to x=0 with overlay (mobile-menu-overlay) and X button (mobile-menu-close) both visible; clicking nav-orcamentos navigates and closes the drawer. Orçamentos list on mobile shows orcamentos-cards (2 cards) and orcamentos-table is hidden; clicking a card opens detail. Ordens de Fabrico on mobile shows ofs-cards (after creating one via Criar Ordem de Fabrico from a quote) and ofs-table is hidden; tabs Ativas/Concluídas toggle correctly. OF detail on mobile shows the big timer banner (of-total-timer-value visible, text '00:00:00', width 318px) and stacked PDF/Declarar Finalizada/Guardar buttons (no clipping). Orçamento detail on mobile: meta grid stacks (single column on 390), internal table has horizontal scroll (scrollWidth=720, clientWidth=356) WITHOUT breaking the page (body overflow=0). Dashboard on mobile and desktop: recharts ResponsiveContainer renders main chart at width=699 on desktop and at viewport width on mobile with no overflow. CRUD pages (artigos, materiais, maquinas, mao-obra, personalizacao) all report body overflow=0 on 390px viewport; Artigos creation dialog opens at full 390 width with stacked fields. Desktop: sidebar permanently visible at x=0, hamburger correctly hidden (lg:hidden works), orcamentos-table and ofs-table visible while cards are not. Body horizontal overflow is 0 on EVERY route tested (/, /orcamentos, /orcamentos/:id, /ordens-fabrico, /ordens-fabrico/:id, /artigos, /materiais, /maquinas, /mao-obra, /personalizacao).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx is clean: header is lg:hidden, aside uses translate-x-full / translate-x-0 driven by `open` state, lg:translate-x-0 forces it visible on desktop. Overlay z-40, sidebar z-50, header z-30 — correct stacking. Clicking any nav item calls setOpen(false) which auto-closes the drawer on navigation. Good a11y: aria-label on toggle and close buttons.

Orcamentos.jsx and OrdensFabrico.jsx correctly mirror the table/cards split with `hidden md:block` and `md:hidden` and provide separate delete-orcamento-mobile-<id> / delete-of-mobile-<id> testids so tests don't collide. Cards use active:bg-gray-50 for touch feedback — good UX.

Orçamento detail internal line table is wrapped in overflow-x-auto with min-w-[720px], which gives the row a guaranteed minimum but does NOT cause body overflow (verified body.scrollWidth==clientWidth). Solid pattern.
OF detail timer banner uses flex-col sm:flex-row and the value text scales correctly — 40px tall, 318px wide on a 390 viewport, fully legible.
PageHeader uses flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between with flex-wrap on the actions group — buttons wrap to next line on mobile without clipping.
Dashboard charts use Recharts ResponsiveContainer so they resize to the parent grid column on both viewports (no fixed widths).

Minor: there is no actual functional issue but the previously reported (iteration_5) Convert-Quote-to-OF roteiro propagation bug was NOT re-tested here as this iteration was scoped to responsive UI only. That HIGH-priority backend bug from iteration_5 may still be open — main agent should verify.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 responsive requirements pass on both viewports)
